answer: I issue one hardware key per mining identity: a walnut-sized secure element bonded to a copper antenna that signs each block nonce with its factory secret and a live timing signal. The chain accepts one identity per attested serial, and the registry burns 2,000 tokens to rekey a lost device. Cloning needs a physical teardown plus a new fab mask, about $180,000 and six weeks per batch; renting 10,000 fake identities would require 10,000 certified devices, each needing a 90-minute optical inspection and a $40 tamper-evident seal before the registry will attest its serial.
